reviews.t: Vibrant even on unbleached hair
reviews.x: Used this on my daughters hair. She has light brown hair naturally, and I've only ever used SFX on her. We leave it in overnight before rinsing out. This is definitely the most vibrant color we've used so far...it's beautiful and shows up great on her unbleached hair.

reviews.t: The Atomic Pink has lasted me 4+ months!
reviews.x: I was using Manic Panic's Hot Hot Pink when I did a little research and discovered people saying that SFX Atomic Pink lasted longer than Manic Panic. I figured I had nothing to lose and took the leap into a new product.  For the first few months, it was very obvious that the color lasted longer than Manic Panic's did. Still, I stuck to my regular touch ups of every four weeks, just because I absolutely love the color straight from the bottle. It's so very bright. I never wanted to actually test

reviews.t: best, highly recommend

As soon as I rinsed it out, I saw how deep and concentrated the color was. I didn't dilute it so it was kind of a deep pretty magenta. I've had the color in about four weeks or so now, and I swear, it hasn't faded; hardly at all. And the small amount of fading that has happened has only made the color a brighter pink instead of the deeper magent

I achieved this color by mixing equal amounts of Blue Mayhem and Pimpin Purple and then diluting the mixture with conditioner. reviews.t: Hi-octane Orange works wonderfully on unbleached hair too!
reviews.x: I love dyeing my hair a vivid red/orange, but as any "redhead" will know, it fades hella fast. I decided to use this as a touch up in between, assuming that it wouldn't be that vivid because my hair is unbleached, but boy, it stands out! Good thing I love having statement hair! It really does start out as cherry red, but fades to a red orange, beware of that. I suggest if you want a initially more orange color mixing it with conditioner.

reviews.t: It worked fantastic and was easy to use
reviews.x: I adore this dye! It worked fantastic and was easy to use, even to a newbie to the world of bright colors. I used Atomic pink, wildflower, and a mix of Blue Haired Freak and Fishbowl. I love how it turned out, my hair is soft and shiny, and I get complements whenever I go out. I can't wait to try some more colors.

reviews.t: Lasts and lasts
reviews.x: I have atomic pink. I lightened my dark blonde hair to lightest blond and this is so bright! It also glows in a black light. This is THE best pink I have ever used and I have used many. Ion, manic panic, Pravana and any other pink I can find. This is it!. I've had this in my hair for months now and only have had to retouch the regrowth a few times and comb through refresh a little. This stays. Everything else I tried would be gone in a week. Not this. It will stay until I bleach it out, so be wa

reviews.t: Diluted Atomic Pink!
reviews.x: I love this hair dye! The Atomic pink stays vibrant for so long even when diluted! I wanted pastel pink hair and knew that Atomic pink stays in hair for a longgg time, so I mixed about half a tablespoon of dye with a crap load of white conditioner. I let it sit for 1-2 hours or longer if I have time. The left photo is right after it's dyed and the right is about 2 weeks later. I usually touch up around 3/4 weeks.

reviews.t: This product is a lot of fun, easy to use
reviews.x: Really lived up to my expectations! I barely used any and it has lasted many washes and kept the vibrancy I craved. This product is a lot of fun, easy to use, and doesn't seem to damage your hair. It also fades far less than Manic Panic. The picture is 3 weeks old after the first use. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.t: My go-to color
reviews.x: I've been dying my hair pink for about 4 years now, and SFX Atomic Pink has become the only dye I ever use! It's less a dye and more a stain; I bleach my hair, rinse, blow dry, apply SFX, leave for an hour, then rinse, and the color lasts *forever.* With daily shampooing (albeit using sulfate-free shampoo and conditioner), I end up reapplying the dye not because it's faded but because my natural-color roots have grown too long. claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the vibrant, bold color, including on unbleached or brown hair.
Many reviewers report the color lasts an exceptionally long time and fades nicely.
Reviewers note the dye can be diluted with conditioner to achieve pastel shades.
Some reviewers describe shipping or seller problems, including damaged or cancelled packages.
One reviewer reports the color came out red rather than pink on bleached hair.
